title: Impaled (Embedded) Object
summary: Leave the object in place. Control bleeding around it and pad it so it cannot move.

callEmergency.headline: Call {EMERGENCY} for a large or deep impaled object
when: Any object impaled in the head, neck, chest, abdomen or groin
Large objects anywhere, or heavy bleeding

steps.title: Do not remove it
steps.text: The object may be plugging the wound. Removing it can cause severe bleeding.

steps.title: Control bleeding around it
steps.text: Press firmly on either side of the object, not on it.

steps.title: Stabilise the object
steps.text: Build padding (rolled bandages, cloth) around the object and bandage over the padding so the object cannot move.

steps.title: If the object is fixed to something
steps.text: Do not try to free the person yourself – wait for rescue services, supporting the person and the object.

doNot: Do not pull the object out
Do not press directly on the object
Do not cut or shorten the object unless rescue services do it
